pages.text: The Dire Smithing Table puts $(l:justdirethings:upgrades)Upgrades$(/l) on $(l:justdirethings:tools)Tools$(/l) and $(l:justdirethings:armor)Armor$(/l). It also raises them a tier with the upgrade templates and makes Paxels. It does regular smithing too.

Put the items in its slots. Tier upgrades and Paxels use all three. Upgrades and regular smithing leave the template slot empty. When the items match a recipe, the result waits in the table until you take it.

Hoppers and pipes can fill the table from any side, in any order. Each item goes in the slot where it fits a recipe. Items that can't be part of a recipe are refused.$(br2)Only the result can be pulled out.
